title: The Lecture Hall
intro: A flexible, historic event space in Toynbee Hall’s Grade II listed building, suited to conferences, lectures and corporate events.

blocks.heading: The space
paragraphs: The ground-floor hall is 111 square metres and accommodates approximately 40–100 people. It combines Victorian character, natural light and contemporary AV facilities.

blocks.heading: Facilities
paragraphs: Step-free access, reliable Wi-Fi, flexible seating layouts, tables and chairs are available. Catering, microphones, lecterns, screens, projectors and event production can be arranged.

blocks.heading: Enquire
paragraphs: Call 020 7392 2920 or email events@toynbeehall.org.uk to check availability and request a quote.
